name: Mass-tort docket tracker, federal MDL pending actions by month since 2019
description: Pending actions in every federal multidistrict litigation (MDL), from the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation's monthly 'Pending MDL Dockets by Actions Pending' reports. One record per docket: the court's docket title, the transferee district, the docket type, actions now pending, actions ever filed, the change over 12 months, the peak pending count, and the docket's monthly pending count since 2019. Version 1.1 adds the 14 MDLs the court closed between 2026-01-01 and 2026-10-01 (dateClosed set, the peak and last count from the monthly series) and the court's reports by district and by docket type, with monthly groupings of the series. Every report's rows add up exactly to the court's own totals row. The full monthly series, judge included, is at /data/v1/mdl/history/index.json (one CSV per year); the district, type and closed-MDL files are at /data/v1/mdl/reports/index.json. Counts and dates only.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Mass-tort docket tracker, federal MDL pending actions by month since 2019 (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116044

distribution.name: mdl.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: mdl.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: mdl-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in mdl-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to mdl.csv on id.

recordSet.name: mdl
recordSet.description: The records of Mass-tort docket tracker, federal MDL pending actions by month since 2019, one per CSV row.

field.name: mdl
field.description: The MDL docket number, e.g. MDL-2738

field.name: title
field.description: The docket title as the court prints it

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: totalActions
field.description: Every action ever part of the MDL

field.name: peakPending
field.description: The highest pending count in the monthly reports since February 2019 (value, for a closed MDL)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
